feeds.title: Linda Germain Blog
feeds.description: Linda Germain is a mixed media printmaker who uses rust, thread and gelatin to create monotype prints. Follow this blog for tips and techniques about monotype printmaking and other mixed media techniques that involve printmaking without a press.

feeds.title: My Printmaking Journey
feeds.description: Follow this blog for observations/discoveries in printmaking and art by Brian Holden.

feeds.title: Colin Blanchard - artist and printmaker Blog
feeds.description: Website of artist and printmaker Colin Blanchard it shows examples of his prints and the way he works!

feeds.title: Kim Herringe
feeds.description: I run small group printmaking workshops from my own studio in North Maleny. Introducing a new and often alternative creative medium to students is exciting. Printmaking can be much easier than people realize, and a great alternative or extension to a painting and drawing arts practice. With a love for printmaking, following a career in graphic design, I love to explore traditional and new printmaking mediums.

feeds.title: Louise Stebbing Printmaker
feeds.description: Multi award winning, Louise Stebbing has been printmaking for over 30 years. Follow this blog to find information on new linocuts, etchings and her experiences on how its created.

feeds.title: Printmakers Council
feeds.description: PMC was founded in 1965 to promote the Art of Printmaking and the work of contemporary printmakers. Here we Provide information on prints and printmaking to both its membership and the public. Follow this blog to find Information about selected artists and other news items chosen by the Printmakers Council.

feeds.title: Saltgrass Printmakers
feeds.description: Saltgrass Printmakers is a non-profit open access print studio offering full time memberships, hourly rates, and workshops. Our goal is to support and promote printmaking as a first-class member of the fine-art community. Here you will get insights on education programs open to the public, open community access to professional-grade printmaking facilities and supporting collaborative opportunities for artists and for the public.

feeds.title: Kathryn Desforges
feeds.description: Kathryn Desforges is an artist and printmaker based in Leeds, West Yorkshire. Follow this blog for thoughts on printmaking and artists' books - ideas, technique, process.

feeds.title: Richard Spare
feeds.description: Richard Spare is a British contemporary artist. Buy limited edition fine art prints and unique artworks online, directly from the artist's studio in London, UK.

feeds.title: UNT Printmaking Blog
feeds.description: The Printmaking Program at the University of North Texas College of Visual Arts and Design offers a broad and intensive experience for serious artists engaging printmaking concepts and processes. Keep up with the latest information and news on printmaking conferences, workshops, and other professional activities.

feeds.title: Boarding All Rows Blog
feeds.description: Blog about linoleum block printmaking and techniques like printing on fabric and linocut reduction prints. Here you will find information on linocut techniques and block printing ink, press, tool and supply recommendations.

feeds.title: Sue Brown Printmaker
feeds.description: Sue Brown is an artist who uses printmaking and enamel to tell stories. She is an artist/maker for 15 years exploring natural and narrative subjects. Springing from the pages of her sketch books and developing carefully researched themes, her work is driven by experimenting with print and contemporary enamel techniques.

feeds.title: OCA Printmaking Blog
feeds.description: Thoughts, ideas, research and development and final outcomes for the OCA Printmaking Level 1 course posted by Becki Pate. Here you will find articles on Combination prints, Lino Printing, Print techniques, Monoprinting and more.

feeds.title: Lynn Bailey
feeds.description: Lynn Bailey is an Eco minded printmaker. Inspired by bugs, hedgerows and reclaimed landfill sites. She makes her printmaking as environmentally friendly as she can & it's STILL magic! Here you will find lot of different printmaking processes and delight in the possibilities and moments of real surprise you get with hands on printmaking.

feeds.title: Little Pulp Blog
feeds.description: Little Pulp is a design print shop focused on producing personalized sketchbooks, notecards and other paper products for children to inspire creativity. Here we write about our printmaking workshop for kids, our custom sketchbooks and other paper products and all things creative with regards to paper.

feeds.title: The Curious Printmaker Blog
feeds.description: This Blog by Emily Harvey is a place to share and inspire curiosity about printmaking.
